title: Snake on the Plains
requirements: Access to the past through Wings of the Goddess.
For first enlistment, obtain a Green recommendation letter. Another nation’s enlistment quest must not be active.
steps: Obtain the Green recommendation letter from Kalsu-Kalasu in Crawlers’ Nest [S] (L-8), if this is your first Campaign enlistment.
Speak to Miah Riyuh and accept the assignment to receive Zonpa-Zippa’s all-purpose putty.
In West Sarutabaruta [S], examine all three Sealed Entrances at F-4, J-8 and F-11. Each consumes part of the putty; the order does not matter.
Return to Miah Riyuh and confirm enlistment. Leave an inventory slot for the first-enlistment shoes.
notes: Completing this quest sets your Campaign allegiance to Windurst.
For the Windurst story, completing Steamed Rams or The Fighting Fourth also satisfies the initial enlistment requirement; changing allegiance is unnecessary.
reward: Cobra Unit Mercenary title; first Campaign enlistment also grants Sprinter’s Shoes and a Bronze Ribbon of Service.
unlocks: The Tigress Stirs
Windurst Campaign enlistment

title: The Tigress Stirs
requirements: Complete Snake on the Plains, Steamed Rams, or The Fighting Fourth.
steps: Speak to Dhea Prandoleh in the northern section of Windurst Waters [S].
In West Sarutabaruta [S], examine the ??? at the base of the Twinkle Tree (I-6) to obtain the Small starfruit.
Return to Windurst Waters [S]. Examine the ground-floor Door: Acolyte Hostel (K-5), the lower/left door, for the ending and reward.
notes: Dhea may be unavailable during a Campaign battle; return after the battle.
The reviewed quest handler accepts any completed nation enlistment and does not require an Inky Black Yagudo Feather.
unlocks: The Tigress Strikes

title: The Tigress Strikes
steps: Speak to Dhea Prandoleh.

Enter Fort Karugo-Narugo [S] and speak to Rotih Moalghett (I-8, inner/Fivespires map). She stands on the upper ledge east of the central Spiritwell. Enter the fort through Cavalry Gate (F-8), or lower the magical barrier using the Phosphorous Ward (I-9).
On the outside map, examine the ??? at I-9 for a cutscene. Prepare, then examine it again to spawn War Lynx.
Defeat War Lynx and examine the ??? again before leaving.
Return to Dhea Prandoleh for completion.
notes: The reviewed handler requires you to change zones after completing this quest.
unlocks: Windurst route prerequisite for finishing Back to the Beginning and reaching Cait Sith.
Knot Quite There, after Back to the Beginning.

title: Knot Quite There
requirements: Complete The Tigress Strikes and the main mission Back to the Beginning.
steps: Examine the ground-floor, lower/left Door: Acolyte Hostel.
Obtain one 108-Knot Quipu from Yagudo in Sauromugue Champaign [S], around the eastern forts at K-9/L-9 via the L-8 ramp; Yagudo near Garlaige Citadel [S]’s second Banishing Gate also drop it.
Examine the Bulwark Gate in Sauromugue Champaign [S] (F-6) for a cutscene, then trade it the quipu. Examine it again for the travel instruction.
Enter Southern San d’Oria [S] from East Ronfaure [S] on foot. A direct town warp does not satisfy the reviewed entry trigger.
Examine Door: House at M-8, the first house on the right beyond the Portcullis, for completion.
notes: If another zone-entry cutscene plays, leave for East Ronfaure [S] and enter again.
unlocks: A Manifest Problem

title: A Manifest Problem
steps: Speak to Rotih Moalghett on the inner/Fivespires map.
Enter Castle Oztroja [S] for a cutscene, then return to Rotih to obtain the Fort key.
Examine the Colorful Door on the inner map at H-5, near the G-6 border, and enter Ghoyu’s Reverie.
Defeat the Yagudo waves, including the final enemy Laa Yaku the Austere. Area attacks and crowd control help manage the groups.
After victory returns you to West Sarutabaruta [S], enter Windurst Waters [S] for the ending.
notes: After a loss, obtain another Fort key from Rotih Moalghett.
reward: Mihgo Mithkabob; Friend of Lehko Habhoka title.
unlocks: Windurst route prerequisite for finishing Cait Sith and reaching The Queen of the Dance.

title: When One Man Is Not Enough
requirements: Complete A Manifest Problem and Purple, The New Black; In the Name of the Father should be current or later.
steps: Speak to Dhea Prandoleh, then examine the Sealed Entrance at the F-10/F-11 boundary in West Sarutabaruta [S].
Return to Dhea for the conversation about fish.
Trade one Pipira to that Sealed Entrance. When asked about giving more, decline to finish and receive the flowers.
Enter Windurst Waters [S] to begin A Feast for Gnats.
notes: An active Snake on the Plains can take priority at the entrance. Complete or cancel that active assignment before retrying.
Other accepted fish change the scene length; one Pipira is sufficient.
unlocks: A Feast for Gnats

title: A Feast for Gnats
requirements: Complete When One Man Is Not Enough.
steps: Enter Windurst Waters [S] for the opening.
Speak to Mham Lahrih in Sauromugue Champaign [S] (K-9), atop the small fort north of the cavernous maw.
Examine the Abandoned Mineshaft at the foot of the nearby stairs for a Signal firecracker. Examine it again when the party is ready to enter Ghoyu’s Reverie.
Clear the initial Quadav around Romaa Mihgo and her Wildcat Volunteers. Destroy the Confederate Belfry while keeping Romaa alive. Attacking the belfry draws additional Quadav; Gigas arrive later.
After the victory scene, report to Dhea Prandoleh (H-10) in Windurst Waters [S].
notes: The objective is the belfry; defeating every reinforcement is unnecessary.
For another attempt, Mham Lahrih supplies a replacement firecracker once per Vana’diel day.
reward: Ruby; Jewel of the Cobra Unit title.
unlocks: Windurst route prerequisite for continuing In the Name of the Father.

title: The Long March North
requirements: Complete A Feast for Gnats and A Nation on the Brink; reach Crossroads of Time.
steps: Enter Windurst Waters [S]. In Southern San d’Oria [S], speak to Raustigne (I-7), then Hauberliond (H-9).
Check the New-turned Earth in the area Hauberliond assigns: East Ronfaure [S] J-11, La Vaule [S] K-9, or Jugner Forest [S] J-5. Receive the Darkfire cinder.
Speak to Striking Snake in the present-day Metalworks gunpowder room (H-7).
Use Pickaxes at North Gustaberg [S] mining points until you obtain Liquid quicksilver and Gelid sulfur.
Return to Striking Snake. Wait until the next Vana’diel day, change zones, and speak again for Beastbane bullets.
Speak to Rotih Moalghett in Fort Karugo-Narugo [S] (I-8, inner map). Prepare before examining the Warding Door at E/F-7: the battle starts immediately.
Defeat Count Furfur, two Count Murmurs and two Tartalos. Recheck the door and collect the reward before leaving.
notes: Hauberliond repeats the assigned location if needed.
Keep a free inventory slot; leaving without collecting the earring can require repeating the fight.
unlocks: The Forbidden Path

title: The Forbidden Path
requirements: Bring a Bottled Pixie and any job Testimony; arrange access beyond Inner Horutoto Ruins’ Three Mage Gate.
steps: Enter Windurst Waters [S]. Collect the following three key items in any order.

Irradiant strand: in present-day Inner Horutoto Ruins, examine Gate of Darkness (I-7, map 4). Enter from East Sarutabaruta J-7 and pass the Three Mage Gate using a Portal Charm or a WHM/BLM/RDM group; an already accessible Toraimarai Canal route also reaches this room.

Scintillant strand: examine Fey Blossoms in Grauberg [S] (F-5) twice, then trade a Bottled Pixie between 18:00 and 06:00. Yagudo High Priests in Meriphataud Mountains [S] and Castle Oztroja [S] drop the bottle.
Refulgent strand: examine the Writhing Flame in Castle Oztroja [S] (G-7, first-map north hallway), then trade any job Testimony.
Speak to Velda-Galda in Windurst Waters [S] (K-9) three times to deliver the strands in separate scenes.
Wait until the next Vana’diel day and speak to Velda-Galda again to collect the reward.
notes: The Testimony need not match your current job. The final potion depends on your current job.
reward: A job-dependent attribute potion; Karaha-Baruha’s Research Assistant title.
unlocks: Windurst route prerequisite for continuing Crossroads of Time.

title: Sins of the Mothers
requirements: Complete The Forbidden Path and The Will of the World; reach Fate in Haze.
steps: Speak to Dhea Prandoleh, then Velda-Galda (K-9).
In Fort Karugo-Narugo [S]’s outside area, examine the Stone Monument (E-7), then the Succulent Cactus (F-5) for a Succulent dragon fruit. Return to the monument.
Examine the Sunken Hollow (G-7) for a cutscene, then again to enter Ghoyu’s Reverie.
Escort both Nhev Befrathi and Syu Befrathi to the exit at G-9 on map 2, proceeding through the first map’s F-9 passage. Talk to each to start or pause movement.
Clear enemies ahead and keep mother and daughter together. Syu runs away from nearby enemies and when separated too far from Nhev. Bring both to the exit.
After returning to West Sarutabaruta [S], enter Windurst Waters [S] for completion.
notes: After failure, obtain another fruit from the cactus on the following Vana’diel day.
unlocks: Howl from the Heavens

title: Howl from the Heavens
requirements: Complete Sins of the Mothers and wait until the next Vana’diel day.
Arrange present-day Magicite access: Crest of Davoi, Silver bell, Coruscant rosary and Black matinee necklace from the nation Magicite route.
steps: Enter Windurst Waters [S] from West Sarutabaruta [S]. Collect the three shards at the present-day Magicites.
Optistone: pass Davoi’s Wall of Dark Arts (G-7) into Monastic Cavern and examine the Magicite.
Aurastone: take Beadeaux’s H-7 tunnel into Qulun Dome at I-7. Pass the sealed door using the bell, rosary and necklace, then examine the Magicite.

Orastone: in Castle Oztroja, operate the I-8 lever and avoid the falling-floor trap. Continue through G-7’s courtyard and I-7’s northern corridor, then light the H-9 torch to pass the Brass Door into the Altar Room. Examine its Magicite.
Speak to Velda-Galda (K-9) in Windurst Waters [S], then exit into West Sarutabaruta [S] for another scene.
Examine the Windurstian Bulwark (J-8) for a scene. Prepare, then examine it again to start the defense.
Defeat the successive Yagudo Parivir, Giganotaur, Kindred Incantor and Blurry Eyes waves. Romaa Mihgo and at least one Protective Ward must survive; prioritize enemies attacking them.
After victory, examine the bulwark again before zoning. Enter Windurst Waters [S] for the reward.
notes: Leaving before the post-battle bulwark scene can force a repeat.
After failure, leave and re-enter West Sarutabaruta [S] before retrying.
unlocks: Windurst route prerequisite for continuing Fate in Haze.

title: Manifest Destiny
requirements: Complete Howl from the Heavens and Darkness Descends; reach Adieu, Lilisette.
Each participant needs three Dorter Keys.
steps: Speak to Dhea, examine the Mithran Bivouac in Meriphataud Mountains [S] (northeast I-8), then enter Castle Oztroja [S] for a scene.
Farm three Dorter Keys per character from Yagudo Eradicators, Knight Templars, Prioresses or Prelates in Meriphataud Mountains [S] or Castle Oztroja [S].
Climb to the castle’s second floor via J-8. On the connecting map, take I-9 or G-7 to the outdoor Iron Grille cells.
Check each grille first. Trade a key only where a presence is detected. Free three prisoners to receive the Poet god’s key; empty cells consume keys without credit.
Return to the connecting map, pass the G-8 door and G-9 passage, and climb to the top. Light a torch to open the Brass Door and reach the Collapsing Floor behind it.
Check the floor for a scene, then again to fight Tzee Xicu the Manifest and two wind elementals. Defeat Tzee Xicu for completion.
notes: Defeating the elementals disables their Astral Flow attacks. Bring Echo Drops for silence.
For a retry, collect another Poet god’s key from the Mithran Bivouac, once per Vana’diel day.
reward: Hi-Reraiser; collect it at the Mithran Bivouac if inventory prevented receipt.
unlocks: At Journey’s End

title: At Journey's End
steps: Examine the Mithran Bivouac at northeast I-8 for another Poet god’s key.
Return to the top of Castle Oztroja [S] using the same route as Manifest Destiny. Light a torch, pass the Brass Door, and examine the Collapsing Floor for the scene and battlefield entry.
Defeat the opponent as it changes between Fenrir, Karaha-Baruha and Robel-Akbel. Keep your assisting NPC, Lehko Habhoka, alive throughout.
After victory, examine the Mithran Bivouac for a scene, then speak to Dhea Prandoleh in Windurst Waters [S] (H-10).
Examine the Sealed Entrance in West Sarutabaruta [S] (F-10/F-11 boundary). Enter Windurst Waters [S] for the final scene and reward.
notes: After a failed battle, return to the Mithran Bivouac for a replacement Poet god’s key.
reward: Zodiac Ring; Star of the Azure Sky title.
unlocks: Windurst route prerequisite for continuing Adieu, Lilisette.
